topics.definition: Cloud computing delivers computing resources such as servers, storage and software over the Internet.
tips: Pay only for the resources you use.

topics.definition: Cloud computing provides on-demand access, scalability, elasticity, resource pooling and measured service.
Cloud deployment models include Public, Private, Hybrid and Community Cloud.
tips: Choose based on security and business needs.

topics.definition: Cloud computing offers flexibility, cost savings, scalability and high availability.
topics.example: Hosting an application in the cloud

topics.definition: Cloud computing may introduce security, privacy, latency and vendor lock-in concerns.
Major cloud providers offer infrastructure and services for businesses and developers.
tips: Compare services before choosing a provider.

topics.definition: Cloud computing supports storage, web hosting, AI, analytics, backups and disaster recovery.
tips: Cloud is used across many industries.

topics.definition: Design secure, scalable and cost-effective cloud solutions.
